label: Bible Study
prompt: But Noah found _____ in the eyes of the LORD.
verse: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
note: The first time 'grace' appears in the KJV — and it lands on Noah, just before the flood.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst _____, all things are possible to him that believeth.
verse: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
note: A desperate father's 'if thou canst' gets turned right around — and he answers, 'help thou mine unbelief.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: There is a _____ here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verse: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
note: The KJV calls him a lad — the boy whose five barley loaves and two small fishes fed five thousand.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your _____ ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verse: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
note: Fallow ground is land left hard and unplowed — Hosea says break the crust before expecting the rain.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of _____; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
verse: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
note: Beauty for ashes, praise for 'heaviness' — from the very passage Jesus read aloud in the Nazareth synagogue.
